bundle_rule: synthetic evaluation overlay at observed activity timestamps; the source trace is a real firefighter exercise but is not an AidMesh deployment
conversion_semantics: one undirected one-second contact per direct local Wi-Fi pair/slot; requires nl80211 connected-time or signal evidence; routed global, cell, Ethernet and virtual edges excluded; capacity is observed byte-counter lower bound subject to the registered minimum
dataset: ENE5AI Dataset (5G and Wi-Fi Mesh Mobility), version 1.0
role_mapping_rule: rank trace node identifiers by total direct-contact duration; assign synthetic sites, relays, then clients with lexical tie-breaking
